adjudication.rationale: Looking at the delete action in embeddable-host.js.es6 lines 42-49, the code calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but there is no `.catch()` handler for the promise. If the destroyRecord() call fails (e.g., network error, server error), the promise rejection will be unhandled and the user will receive no feedback about the failure. This contrasts with the save() action which properly uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)` to handle errors. This is a real bug where error handling is missing.
